title: Grateful Dead Live at Pelletier Farm on 1969-08-23

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show with a soaring Dark Star and wild Love Light jam; recording source unknown but listeners find it listenable.
ai_review.review: The concert is remembered for an incredible, gong‑heavy Dark Star that ventures into spooky space and a wildly improvisational Love Light segment. Reviewers also praise the Merle Haggard cover “Mama Tried.” No specific complaints about audio quality were noted, suggesting the recording is at least adequate for enjoyment.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are strongly positive (average 4.5 stars) and highlight standout performances; lack of concrete recording details keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not mention clarity, mix issues, or source type, implying no major problems with the audio.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Improvisational set with strong space sections and a notable cover, creating an engaging flow.

band_member_comments.Keys: Question about organ on H2H – possibly Pigpen or Tom Constanten.
